Admin.backupDeleteText: "{name}" and its archive will be removed.
Admin.backupNameHelp: Left blank, it is named for today's date and time.
Admin.backupSectionDesc: Download the site as a zip. Each one is kept here as a restore point.
Admin.categoriesDesc: The sub-categories entries are filed under.
Admin.contactSectionDesc: How readers reach the journal. Published on the site.
Admin.countiesDesc: The counties a place can be filed under.
Admin.countyCount: {count, plural, =0 {no counties} one {# county} other {# counties}}
Admin.countriesDesc: The countries a state belongs to.
Admin.stateCount: {count, plural, =0 {no states} one {# state} other {# states}}
Admin.enhanceOptionsText: Choose how long the result should be.
Admin.errorDeleteProtected: Other records still point at this one. Remove or reassign them first.
Admin.errorGenerateAssets: Could not generate the icons from this logo.
Admin.framedHeadingIntro: Wraps page and section headings in a thin outline. With a brandmark uploaded, the mark sits on the top edge.
Admin.framedHeadingNoBrandmark: Upload a brandmark above to put a mark on the frame.
Admin.googleFontUrlHelp: The css2 URL from fonts.google.com, including every family.
Admin.googleFontUrlInvalid: Must be an https URL on fonts.googleapis.com.
Admin.imagesIntro: Upload several at once and drag to arrange them. The first one is the main image - it is what shows on cards and as the page hero.
Admin.logoAssetsModalText: The favicon and every app icon can be built from the logo you just uploaded.
Admin.logosAndStylesDesc: Logos, icons, colours, fonts and the watermark.
Admin.mapPickerHint: Click the map to drop the pin, or drag the pin to adjust it. Drag the map to pan, Ctrl + scroll to zoom. Leave the pin off to use the place’s own coordinates.
Admin.mapSearchEmpty: No place found with that name.
Admin.mapSearchError: The place search could not be completed.
Admin.mapZoomHint: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
Admin.mapZoomHintMac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
Admin.manifestOptionsText: An installed app icon is cropped into a rounded mask, so it needs a background and some padding.
Admin.manifestPreviewCaption: How it will look once installed
Admin.geographyHint: Every place above is filed under a county, each county belongs to a state, and each state to a country. Add one here and it is available on every location form.
Admin.geographyEmpty: No countries yet. Add one above, then its states and their counties.
Admin.geographyDuplicate: That name is already in the list.
Admin.mediaClipsIntro: Video files for this entry. Unlike the photos above, each one is saved the moment you add it, then converted for the web in the background.
Admin.mediaVideoDropzone: Drop a video here, or click to choose one
Admin.mediaVideoFailed: This clip could not be converted.
Admin.mediaLinksIntro: A video hosted somewhere else - YouTube, Vimeo, or a direct link to a file. Nothing is uploaded.
Admin.mediaUrlHelp: YouTube, Vimeo, or a direct link to a video file.
Admin.mediaVideoHelp: Up to 3 GB. It uploads in the background, then is converted for the web.
Admin.monthsHelp: An entry with no season picked gets the one whose months contain its date.
Admin.name: Name
Admin.statesDesc: The states a county belongs to, and the country each one is in.
Admin.restoreConfirmMerge: Records in the archive will be created or updated. Nothing else is touched.
Admin.restoreConfirmReplace: The selected sections will be deleted and rebuilt from the file. This cannot be undone.
Admin.restoreModeMergeHelp: Updates what the archive contains and leaves everything else alone.
Admin.restoreModeReplaceHelp: Deletes the selected sections and rebuilds them from the archive.
Admin.restoreSectionDesc: Upload an archive and write it back over this site.
Admin.seasonsDesc: The year's seasons and the months each covers.
Admin.sightingsDesc: Every recorded encounter, with its photos and video.
Admin.sortRowsHint: Drag a row by its handle, then turn Reorder off to save.
Admin.speciesDesc: The catalogued subjects and their reference photos.
Admin.systemDesc: Name, description, contact, backup and restore.
Admin.title: Title
Admin.typographyIntro: One Google Fonts stylesheet can load both faces. Leave all three blank to keep the default.
Admin.typographyPreviewBody: Two of them stepped out of the treeline just after six, and stayed long enough to be counted.
Admin.usersClaimsNote: A change here reaches someone the next time they sign in.
Admin.usersDesc: Who has an account, and who may edit the site.
Admin.watermarkIntro: Tiles the logo faintly behind every public page, over the page background.
Admin.watermarkPreviewBody: The pattern should be readable as texture and never compete with the text over it.
Admin.watermarkPreviewThemeHint: Switch the theme to tune the other background.
Admin.weatherDesc: The weather conditions an entry can record.
Admin.welcomeSubtitle: Everything the journal publishes is edited from here.
Admin.searchListHint: Searches every record, not just the rows on screen.
Admin.videoUploadBusy: The server is busy converting other clips. Try again in a few minutes.
Admin.videoIntro: How an uploaded clip is re-encoded before it is stored. Applies to the next upload — clips already converted are not redone.
Admin.videoResolutionHelp: Clips larger than this are scaled down. A smaller clip is left at its own size.
Admin.videoQualityHelp: Higher quality means a larger file and slower conversion.
Admin.videoCodecHelp: H.264 plays in every browser. This is the safe choice.
Admin.videoCodecHevcWarning: HEVC files are about 30% smaller, but Firefox and many desktop browsers cannot play them at all. Visitors on those browsers will see nothing.
Admin.mapIntro: Which basemap every map on the site is drawn from - the public maps and the coordinate picker in this CMS.
Admin.mapStyleHelp: This picks a style, not what the style shows. The maps draw finished tile images, so buildings, roads and labels are already painted into them - to leave a layer out, author a style in your tile provider's own editor with that layer deleted and point Custom at the raster endpoint it publishes.
Admin.mapTileUrlHelp: Must contain '{z}', '{x}' and '{y}', which are replaced per tile. A provider key may ride in it as '?key=...' - it is fetched by the visitor's browser and is therefore public, so restrict it by origin at the provider.
Admin.mapCreditHelp: Shown in the corner of every map. Required by every tile provider; left blank, the OpenStreetMap credit is used.
Admin.mapCreditUrlHelp: Where the credit links. Most tile providers require it to point back at them; left blank, the credit is drawn as plain text.

AdminImageUploader.dropzoneText: Drop an image here, or click to choose one
AdminImageUploader.maxReached: That is the maximum number of images.

Contribute.speciesIntro: Propose something new for {category}. An editor reviews it before it joins the catalog.
Contribute.speciesMetaDescription: Propose a new species for the catalog. An editor reviews every contribution.
Contribute.sightingIntro: Record an encounter with {species}. An editor reviews it before it appears in the journal.
Contribute.sightingIntroAny: Record an encounter for the field journal. An editor reviews it before it appears.
Contribute.sightingMetaDescription: Record an encounter for the field journal. An editor reviews every contribution.
Contribute.speciesStage1Description: A name and at least one photograph. Everything else can wait for the next step.
Contribute.speciesStage2Description: All optional. Leave a field blank rather than guessing - an editor can fill it in.
Contribute.sightingStage1Description: The day, the place, and at least one photograph of the encounter.
Contribute.sightingStage1DescriptionAny: The species, the day, the place, and at least one photograph of the encounter.
Contribute.sightingStage2Description: All optional, including who to credit. Add what you noted and skip the rest.
Contribute.reviewDescription: This is what will be filed. Step back to change anything.
Contribute.speciesNameHelp: What you would call it - not the Latin name.
Contribute.scientificNameHelp: The binomial, if you know it - e.g. Canis latrans.
Contribute.shortDescriptionHelp: One line, shown on cards and in listings.
Contribute.descriptionHelp: How to recognise it, where it lives, what it does.
Contribute.sightingNameHelp: Filled in from the date, time, species and place so no two entries share a title. Change it to anything you like.
Contribute.storyHelp: The encounter in your own words.
Contribute.dateHelp: The day of the encounter. The season is worked out from it.
Contribute.placeHelp: Type to search by name, kind of place or county.
Contribute.noPlaces: No places have been catalogued yet, so a sighting cannot be filed. Please try again later.
Contribute.creditFromAccount: Entries you file are credited to {name}, the first name on your account.
Contribute.creditNoAccountName: Your account has no first name, so this entry will show no credit. Add one in your account settings to be named.
Contribute.anonymousHelp: Your name is not shown. Your account still records the submission.
Contribute.pendingNotice: Nothing is published straight away: an editor reviews every contribution first.
Contribute.failed: The submission could not be saved. Please try again.
Contribute.photoEmpty: At least one photograph is needed.
Contribute.photoCounter: {count} of {max}. The first one is the cover.
Contribute.photoTooLarge: One file was too large and was skipped.
Contribute.photoTooMany: Only {max, plural, one {# photograph} other {# photographs}} can be added.
Contribute.photoUnreadable: One file could not be read and was skipped.
Contribute.submittedDescription: Thank you. An editor will review it, and it appears on the site once it is approved - so you will not find it there yet.
Contribute.signInSpecies: Contributions are credited and reviewed, so an account is needed before you can propose a species for {category}.
Contribute.signInSighting: Contributions are credited and reviewed, so an account is needed before you can record an encounter with {species}.
Contribute.signInSightingAny: Contributions are credited and reviewed, so an account is needed before you can record an encounter.
Contribute.signUpHint: You can create an account on the same page.
Contribute.videoHelp: Optional. One clip, up to {seconds} seconds. It is converted for the web after you submit.
Contribute.videoTooLong: That clip is longer than {seconds} seconds. Please trim it first.
Contribute.videoUploadingNotice: Your entry is filed. Please keep this page open until the video finishes - leaving or refreshing cancels the upload.
Contribute.videoFailed: Your entry was filed, but the video could not be uploaded. You can add it later.
Contribute.videoBusy: Your entry was filed, but the server was busy converting other clips. You can add the video later.
Contribute.placeIntro: Add somewhere things can be seen - a park, a pond, a trail. An editor reviews it before it joins the catalogue.
Contribute.placeMetaDescription: Add a place to the field journal's catalogue. An editor reviews every contribution.
Contribute.placeFormDescription: A name and a pin on the map are all that is needed. You can file a sighting here straight away.
Contribute.placeNameHelp: What it is called locally - e.g. Lake Estes.
Contribute.placePinHelp: Search for it, or tap the map to drop the pin. Drag the pin to move it.
Contribute.placeCountyHelp: Optional. It is what tells two places of the same name apart.
Contribute.placeParentHelp: Optional - a trail inside its park, a pond inside a reserve.
Contribute.placePhotosHelp: Optional. A photograph of the place itself, not of what you saw there.
Contribute.placePendingNotice: The place is added straight away so you can file a sighting at it, but it stays hidden from the site until an editor approves it.
Contribute.signInPlace: Contributions are credited and reviewed, so an account is needed before you can add a place.

Contributions.editNotice: This is not on the public site yet, so your changes simply update what a reviewer will see.
Contributions.editPlaceDescription: Correct the name, the pin, or anything else about the place you added.
Contributions.editWarning: This contribution is published. Saving a change takes it off the public site until a reviewer approves the new version.
Contributions.editWarningTitle: This will come off the site
Contributions.empty: Once you add a species, a place or a sighting, it will appear here so you can follow it through review.
Contributions.emptyFiltered: No contribution matches these filters. Try widening them.
Contributions.gone: This contribution does not exist, or is not one of yours.
Contributions.intro: Everything you have filed here, whether it is live yet or still waiting for a look.
Contributions.keepVideoHelp: Turn this off to remove the clip from this entry. You cannot replace it here - remove it, save, then add a new one.
Contributions.loadFailed: Your contributions could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
Contributions.metaDescription: Everything you have added to this journal, and where each of it stands.
Contributions.saved: Your changes have been saved and are waiting for review.
Contributions.savedUnpublished: Your changes have been saved. This has come off the public site until a reviewer approves them.
Contributions.signIn: Sign in to see the species, places and sightings you have added, and to correct or withdraw any of them.
Contributions.statusHelp_in_review: Your edit is waiting to be approved. Until it is, this is not on the public site.
Contributions.statusHelp_pending: Filed and waiting for a reviewer. It is not on the public site yet.
Contributions.statusHelp_published: This is live on the site. Editing it will take it off again until the change is approved.
Contributions.title: My contributions
Contributions.withdrawConfirm: This deletes it and its photographs permanently. There is no undo.
Contributions.withdrawConfirmPublished: This is on the public site. Deleting it removes its page and its photographs permanently. There is no undo.
Contributions.withdrawHelp: This deletes it permanently, along with its photographs. There is no undo.
Contributions.withdrawPublished: This is live on the site. Withdrawing it deletes it permanently, along with its photographs, and removes its page. There is no undo.
